$comment: Authored 2026-07-31 to re-shoot the four Home boards that were captured as copies of one another. Two causes, both now fixed in the harness: (1) react-navigation keeps the previous route MOUNTED under display:none and it comes FIRST in document order, so byText resolved every tab click to a 0x0 ghost — clickable() now matches only rendered elements; (2) an injected RPC fault is invisible until Home is forced past fetchTokens' 5-minute cache, which only a pull-to-refresh does — hence the new `pull` act.
$order: home-activity is re-shot FIRST so the tab boards have a live sibling to be asserted against, and the two fault boards come LAST because a fault survives until the group ends.

states.note: the wallet hub: balance, the three tabs, and the Activity tab's empty history — the fixture wallet has no transactions, so this IS the empty state (a populated list is not capturable today)
the Assets tab, populated from the fixture Safe's real balances
the Connections tab — one dApp session at a time, by design
every chain rate-limited: the balance is served from cache and NO banner appears — looking normal is the designed behaviour for a transient fault, not a missing state

states.$why: the fault is injected at RUNTIME and then pulled through, not armed before boot: arming it first destroys the cached balance and the board comes out reading $0.00, which is the opposite of what this state is supposed to show.
states.note: every chain's RPC failing: the last-known balance stays on screen above a warning card listing each unreachable network with a Fix action
